text: `bash tests/run.sh integration command-recovery-dryrun && bash tests/run.sh integration bridges-toggle-dryrun` with new cases tagged `BL-057`: the privacy case run against an empty artifact directory fails (red before: it passes); against a directory with one clean report it passes; against a report holding `cert=` and 20 base64 characters it fails. `grep -q 'fingerprint prefix' docs/qualification.md` covers BL-034
why: The code under claim is harness code under tests/ (tests/live/fault-lib.sh nd_reports_present), and prove-claim refuses any break under tests/ ('the break touches a test file'). Amended under master OD-4 (Rule wrong-check): the same mutant was run by hand. Break: nd_reports_present's fail line replaced by ': "$f"' (git apply of the break patch, from a backup copy). Under it the Test went RED: command-recovery-dryrun 10/11 (run 20261119T194212Z-f46f274b) and bridges-toggle-dryrun 9/10 (20261119T194347Z-b9dccf15), both 'BL-057: an empty evidence directory fails the privacy case: expected [1] got [0]'. Restored from the copy; git diff against the index empty; grep -F of the fail line finds 1. Green with the fix: 11/11 (20261119T193534Z-3e36ee43) and 10/10 (20261119T193709Z-79519abe); RED before the fix existed: 20261119T193112Z-6ab4105a, 20261119T193247Z-72a5ba72.
